name: dumbbell jefferson curl
description: Slow, light-loaded spinal roll down and up that builds control and flexibility in the back and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand on a low step holding a light dumbbell in front of you.
Tuck your chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let the dumbbell hang near your shins.
Pause at the bottom, then roll up slowly.
Keep the weight light and the movement smooth.
